content_sections.heading: What is Sainik School Kunjpura Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Sainik School Kunjpura Recruitment 2026 is conducted for appointment of eligible candidates to teaching and non-teaching positions in Sainik School Kunjpura, Karnal. The vacancies are available on regular and contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Kunjpura Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Graduate in General Science with minimum 50% marks in concerned subjects (Chemistry, Botany, Zoology). OR Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized institution with minimum 50% marks. B.Ed or equivalent degree. Passed CTET/STET. Graduate in Hindi & Sanskrit with minimum 50% marks. OR Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized institution. B.Ed or equivalent degree. Passed CTET/STET. Graduate with minimum 50% marks in Mathematics with required subject combination. B.Ed or equivalent degree. Passed CTET/STET. Graduate with minimum 50% marks in English. B.Ed or equivalent degree. Passed CTET/STET. Matriculation or equivalent qualification. Undergone Horse Riding Instructor Course. Potential Band Master/Band Major/Drum Major course from AEC Training College and Centre Pachmarhi or equivalent course. Matriculation or equivalent. Minimum 5 years experience of running a catering organization. Knowledge of maintaining mess accounts and computer applications. Nursing Diploma/Diploma in General Nursing & Midwife/B.Sc Nursing. Minimum 5 years experience after training. Passed Matriculation. Good communication skills, preferably in English.

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Kunjpura Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for written test, practical test and interview as applicable. The list of shortlisted candidates will be published on the school website and candidates will also be informed through email and post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates have to submit a non-refundable application fee of ₹500 through Bank Draft drawn in favour of Principal, Sainik School Kunjpura, Karnal (Haryana), payable at Karnal.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Sainik School Kunjpura Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of Sainik School Kunjpura. Download the prescribed application format. Fill the application form with required details. Attach self-attested copies of certificates, testimonials, experience documents and photograph. Send the completed application form to the Principal, Sainik School Kunjpura, Karnal (Haryana) - 132023. Ensure the application reaches before 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is Sainik School Kunjpura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Sainik School Kunjpura Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive for teaching and non-teaching staff posts at Sainik School Kunjpura, Karnal.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Sainik School Kunjpura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 15 vacancies are available for TGT and various contractual posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Sainik School Kunjpura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for Sainik School Kunjpura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply offline by submitting the prescribed application form with required documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Sainik School Kunjpura TGT posts?
faq.answer: Candidates should have the required graduation qualification, B.Ed degree and CTET/STET qualification as applicable.

faq.answer: The salary ranges from ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month for contractual posts, while TGT posts carry Level-7 pay.
